_comment: SYNTHETIC test brief. Not from Freya. Invented to test schema-independent JSON ingestion. The key names are arbitrary on purpose.

scenario.title: Harbor Mutual home insurance renewal reminder
scenario.goal: Remind the policyholder that their home policy renews in 30 days and confirm their contact details.

guidelines: Confirm you are speaking to the named policyholder before mentioning the policy.
If someone else answers, do not disclose why you are calling.
The assistant may offer to call back at a time that suits the policyholder.
If the policyholder asks to cancel, transfer the call to the retention team.

closing.text: End the call after confirming the contact details. Thank the policyholder before ending the call.
